name: Curd
description: Set curd broken with a knife: soft-cornered lumps of every proportion.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: @rand(2%, 8%); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: @repeat(4, @rand(6%, 40%)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
